# 2 Export and report

## Outcome
I want the processed records exported and a report written so that a reader sees what changed.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-1 (behavioral): Given processed records, When export runs, Then an export file is written with one row per record.
- AC-2 (property): For all exported rows, the record id is verbatim from the input.
- AC-3 (behavioral): Given an export file, When report runs, Then a report page names the counts per stage.

## Slices
1. `2.1` — export stage
2. `2.2` — report stage
